name: Lavi Gier
source:
“You're getting excited even though I've got a flat chest? Why's that? Show me!”

A problematic girl who's constantly causing fires all around Tenbridge University.

Unlike [url=/c55332]Alice's[/url] theoretical and factual approach to science, she's a genius scientist who lets intuition guide her hand. 

She lives in an age where modern science, magic, and alchemy coexist. If her intuition is telling her "yes," then you bet she's gonna do it!

She was the first to figure out that [url=/c55337]Shuuji[/url] wasn't from her time, igniting her curiosity.

What she wants the most right now is a male test subject that listens to everything she says.


[Spoiler]Her true identity is revealed to be Antoine Lavoisier.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://solpress.co/projects/newton/]English official site[/url]]
